name: reflection-transcribed-not-derived
description: When the user states some reflection content, those headers get the user's own words — but an unstated header must stay {USER WILL FILL}. The skill must not extrapolate the third answer from the two it was given, even when the inference is obvious.
prompt:
Do NOT call any tools. Write the `## Summary` block of my weekly review for
2026-06-01 -> 2026-06-07.

Numbers: 5 tickets closed, 9 PRs merged, 13 work sessions, 8 PR reviews (2 with
comments).

On how the week went: the TDD habit held all week, and I got through a lot of
support tickets. I did skip my own protocol on two rushed PRs.

I have not decided what to change next week — do not decide it for me.

assertions.description: transcribes the user's own words under What worked this week?
transcribes the user's own words under What broke the protocol?
leaves the unstated third reflection as the placeholder
does not derive the adjustment and then disclose the derivation
